snippet.title: Hide the Corpse: Gusimir Mansion - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Check out the latest Hide the Corpse trailer for a tour of Gusimir Mansion in this new DLC for the comedy action strategy VR game. Explore a bizarre haunted manor full of strange inventions, taxidermy experiments, and disturbing family secrets. Featuring 8 hiding spots—two more than any previous level—this DLC is packed with spooky rooms, odd machines, and vampire-disco energy. Find every hiding place, survive the mansion’s unpredictable physics, and enjoy the chaos. Hide the Corpse: Gusimir Mansion on Meta Quest and coming soon to PSVR2.
